company.description:
Immersive Gamebox is an immersive entertainment platform that delivers immersive team adventures in the interactive digital smart rooms. The company's GameBox Adventure pods combine projection mapping, touch screen, motion tracking, and surround sound technologies to create an entirely new form of digital group entertainment.

Immersive Gamebox was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in London, England.

aiResearchSummary.text: Immersive Gamebox is researching and developing a touchscreen display system featuring a frameless display screen and an image rendering component configured to receive detected touch input and determine associated actions, as described in Touchscreen display system. Additionally, they are working on a game delivery system for distributed venues, where local units serve gameplay areas and are coupled to multimedia gaming equipment, as outlined in Game Delivery System. These efforts focus on interactive digital smart rooms and distributed gaming experiences.
